name: KOSSAN
recent: Kossan 在 2026 年 11 月 18 日公布季度业绩，并宣布派发每股 2.5 仙的中期股息。近期有多项大股东（包括 EPF 与 Aberdeen 系基金）的持股变动申报，以及公司秘书变更。10 月底有一项清盘 / 接管相关公告。
notable: 宣布 2026 财政年每股 2.5 仙的单层免税中期股息。
2026 年第三季净利按年增长超过两倍至约 8,731 万令吉。
公司秘书出现变更，涉及 SII SHIEW YEE 与 CHIA YEW NGO。
risks: 10 月 27 日有一项关于清盘 / 接管人 / 限制令 / 特别管理人的公告。
大股东 EPF 及 Aberdeen 系基金在 10 月至 11 月间有多项持股变动申报。
董事总经理在闭市期前表示有意进行证券交易。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 5.689 亿令吉，按季增长 20.9%，按年增长 48.8%；净利为 6,447 万令吉，按季增长 63.1%，按年增长 106.9%；净利率为 11.3%，高于上一季的 8.4%。

recent_en: Kossan announced its quarterly results on 18 Nov 2026 and declared an interim dividend of 2.5 sen per share. There were recent substantial shareholder filings (including EPF and Aberdeen entities) and a change of company secretary. A winding-up/receiver-related announcement was made in late October.
notable_en: Declared an interim single-tier tax-exempt dividend of 2.5 sen per share for FY2026.
3Q26 net profit more than doubled year-on-year to about RM87.31 million.
Change of company secretary involving SII SHIEW YEE and CHIA YEW NGO.
risks_en: A winding-up/receiver/restraining order/special administrator announcement was made on 27 Oct.
Multiple substantial shareholder filings by EPF and Aberdeen entities between October and November.
The Group Managing Director indicated intention to deal in securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was RM568.9 million, up 20.9% QoQ and 48.8% YoY; net income was RM64.5 million, up 63.1% QoQ and 106.9% YoY; net margin was 11.3% versus 8.4% in the prior quarter.
